propositions: module_size_trend and cap_change_events metric IDs are advertised in docs but not registered or computed in git_metrics.py

Both metrics must walk commits reachable from HEAD, filter by --since/--until date range, sort deterministically, and require at least two qualified revisions (with valid cap blob and tracked Python modules) or return Unavailable with reason

module_size_trend must retain every qualified revision if ≤50, else 50 evenly spaced endpoint-inclusive samples, reporting total count and each sample's SHA, timestamp, cap, module count, and max LOC (newline-counted from tracked blobs)

cap_change_events must compare adjacent qualified revisions before sampling and return ordered {from, to, sha, timestamp} change pairs; a history with no changes returns an empty event list, not Unavailable
Both specs must register with lens=code_health, source=git, confidence=high provenance and integrate with existing open metrics CLI/schema without per-ID schema changes

Existing deregistration tests must become live metric coverage tests, freed-ID parameterization must drop module_size_trend while retaining commit_cadence_trend, and Git history/unavailable/registry/CLI tests must cover all error paths
